later_input_regression.before_result: Rechecking an interrupted record replaced retained later requirements with the original instruction.
later_input_regression.after_result: The added regression passes in the final 635-test run; retained requirements survive recheck and close.

checks.syntax: Changed Python modules AST-parse; node --check passed for learning_request.js, learning.js and verify_learning_requests.cjs.
checks.visual_review: Light and dark 1440px recovery screenshots inspected. Original-request controls and later requirements are readable; eight desktop layouts pass overflow and button hit-testing.
checks.resumption_audit: Final logs and six suite results were inspected after resuming on 2026-11-02; all 16 implementation/test files predate their final verification results.

behavior.original_request: Persist before dispatch, isolate by tenant/principal/workspace/purpose/run, preserve original request body during explicit retry.
behavior.read_only_recovery: No automatic model replay; only a typed missing response offers retry, and recovered results require explicit adoption.
behavior.late_reply_protection: Captured workspace plus session, route and identity guards; verify original request ID, purpose and payload SHA-256 before adopting.
behavior.later_requirements: Persist separately from the immutable request; retain after result adoption and when rechecking an interrupted record.
behavior.storage_failure: Keep same-page memory recovery and disclose refresh limitations; malformed or replaced records are not sent, overwritten or cleared silently.
behavior.forgetting: Explicit confirmation explains that clearing this tab entry does not cancel the original generation.

limitations: Recovery uses current-tab sessionStorage; closing the tab may remove this entry depending on browser behavior. Accepted proposals remain in server history.
Only later instruction text is retained as a follow-up draft; a new generation still requires reviewing current Agent, sources, mode and model consent.
Closing the pending dialog or clearing its recovery entry does not cancel generation.
Existing server acceptance, revision, source, deadline and backup rules remain in force.
No external model was invoked; browser fixtures use temporary data and controlled offline generation.
No release package was built or deployed.
